---
applyTo: "plugins/*/agents/**,plugins/*/commands/**,plugins/*/.claude-plugin/**,plugins/*/.cursor-plugin/**,plugins/*/mcp.json,.github/plugin/**,.cursor-plugin/**"
---

# Agents, commands and generated files

## Where things are authored

- Agents: `plugins/<name>/agents/<agent>.agent.md`. One file, read by Copilot and Claude Code.
- Commands: `plugins/<name>/commands/<command>.md`.
- There is no `com.github.copilot/` folder and no Agent Plugins `$schema`. Flag any plugin that adds either: a `$schema` switches Copilot to rules that ignore the root `agents/` folder.
- Hooks: avoid them in shared plugins; their behaviour differs between clients.

## Agent rules

- File name is `<name>.agent.md`, and frontmatter `name` matches it.
- Frontmatter has `name` and `description`. No `tools`: Copilot and Claude Code use different tool names, so a shared agent must not list them. State limits in the body instead (for example "You are read-only").
- Agents stay thin: they find inputs and delegate to a skill. Flag review rules, procedures or domain logic written into an agent; move them into the skill.
- Don't set `model:`.

## Command rules

- Frontmatter has `description`, and `argument-hint` if it takes input.
- No client-specific argument variables (such as `$ARGUMENTS`) in the body.

## Generated files

These are generated by `scripts/sync_manifests.py` and must never be edited by hand:

- `plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, `mcp.json` (the Cursor copy of `.mcp.json`)
- `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`

If a generated file changes without a matching change to its source in the same PR, flag it as a hand edit.
